meta_data.base_class: Provides a specific list of <footwear type> recommendations for common foot conditions. - applicable for querying various types of footwear that need to be selected based on specific foot conditions (e.g., plantar fasciitis, flat feet).

tool_template.name: <class>_prep
tool_template.description: Provides a specific list of <class> recommendations for common foot conditions.

foot_condition.description: Type of foot condition, e.g., plantar fasciitis, flat feet.

gender.description: The gender for which the <class> are designed. Options: 'male', 'female' or 'unisex'.

budget_range.description: The budget range for purchasing the <class>, e.g., low, medium, high.

material_preference.description: Preferred material for the <class>, e.g., leather, synthetic, mesh.
